_README: Materials catalogue. Costs are delivered cost per unit unless noted. Aggregate prices are supplier-specific — `supplier` field tagged on each entry. Suppliers: Upland's Gravel (suffix `_uplands`, central Vancouver Island), Northwin Gravel (suffix `_northwin`), Browns River Pit (suffix `_brownsriver`, serves Courtenay / Comox / Cumberland). Pick the supplier closest to the job site.

lock_block_no1.name: Lock block (No. 1)
lock_block_no1.notes: 5 ft × 2.5 ft × 2.5 ft, ~5,000 lb each. Trucking: 16 blocks/load at $850/load (heavy haul). Use trucking key block_delivery.

lock_block_no2.name: Lock block (No. 2)
lock_block_no2.notes: 5 ft × 2.5 ft × 2.5 ft, ~5,000 lb each. Trucking: 16 blocks/load at $850/load (heavy haul). Use trucking key block_delivery.

magnum_stone_block.name: Magnum stone block (4 ft × 2 ft × 2 ft)
magnum_stone_block.notes: ~1,800 lb each. Trucking: 26 blocks/load at $850/load (heavy haul). Use trucking key block_delivery.

diesel.name: Diesel (fuel estimate)
diesel.notes: Per-litre rate at $2.25 (2026-04-25). For a quick dollar estimate, add a freeform Materials line instead — set quantity=1 and unit_cost=$600 (or whatever).

rip_rap_1_3ft_uplands.name: Rip rap 1-3 ft (Upland's)
rip_rap_1_3ft_uplands.notes: $39/cu_yd alternative if billed by volume. ~3/4 ton per 3-ft boulder for AI estimating.

rip_rap_3plus_uplands.name: Rip rap 3 ft+ / Blast rock (Upland's)
rip_rap_3plus_uplands.notes: Same product as 'blast rock' — interchangeable trade terms. $28/ton. $39/cu_yd alternative if billed by volume. ~3/4 ton per 3-ft boulder for AI estimating.

road_crush_34_brownsriver.name: 3/4" road crush (Browns River)
road_crush_34_brownsriver.notes: Range $23-24/cu_yd; using $23.50 midpoint. Serves Courtenay / Comox / Cumberland.

clear_blue_chip_brownsriver.name: Clear blue chip (Browns River)
clear_blue_chip_brownsriver.notes: Same price as standard blue chip ($63/cu_yd). Serves Courtenay / Comox / Cumberland.

drain_pipe.name: 4" perforated drain pipe (100 ft roll)
drain_pipe.notes: Sold in 100 ft rolls only. 1 roll covers any wall ≤ 100 ft. 2 rolls for 100-200 ft, etc.

filter_fabric.name: Landscape / filter fabric (roll)
filter_fabric.notes: Same product whether called 'landscape fabric' or 'filter fabric' (geotextile). $240/roll. Each roll is 5 ft × 250 ft = 1250 sq ft. Multiple rolls overlap each other so effective coverage is slightly less — round UP when computing roll count. Standard for retaining walls < 50 ft is 1 roll.

concrete.name: Concrete (delivered, per cu m)
concrete.notes: $425/cu m delivered. Includes delivery within ~1 hour of supplier. Loads under 3.5 cu m have a $150 small-load surcharge — see concrete_small_load_surcharge.

concrete_small_load_surcharge.name: Concrete small-load surcharge (under 3.5 cu m)
concrete_small_load_surcharge.notes: Auto-add when total concrete volume on the pad is under 3.5 cu m.

concrete_finish_flat.name: Concrete flat finish (per sq ft)
concrete_finish_flat.notes: Standard troweled flat finish. Quantity = pad sq ft.

concrete_finish_exposed.name: Concrete exposed-aggregate finish (per sq ft)
concrete_finish_exposed.notes: Exposed-aggregate finish. Quantity = pad sq ft.

rebar_10mm_20ft.name: Rebar — 10 mm × 20 ft length
rebar_10mm_20ft.notes: Standard for residential pads. Quantity = number of 20-ft sticks. For a grid layout with bars in both axes at S-foot spacing on an L×W pad, total linear ft = L × (ceil(W/S)+1) + W × (ceil(L/S)+1); sticks = ceil(total_lf / 20).

rebar_accessories.name: Rebar tie wire + chairs (per linear ft)
rebar_accessories.notes: Bundled estimate: tie wire (~1 roll per 500 lf) + plastic chairs every ~4 ft. Quantity = total linear ft of rebar on the pad.

concrete_forms.name: Concrete forms (lump)
concrete_forms.notes: Standard $250 for typical residential pads. Michael overrides with a different number when it's a really big pad. Parser auto-uses $250 unless contractor states a different dollar amount in voice.
